column1: Deck Name: IT Basics - Security & Safety
What is Phishing?;A scam where attackers pretend to be a trusted entity (via email/text) to steal your data.;security
What is Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?;A second layer of security requiring something you know (password) and something you have (phone/code).;security
Why use a Password Manager?;It generates and stores complex unique passwords so you don't have to remember them.;security
What is Malware?;Malicious software designed to harm or exploit your computer (viruses
What does HTTPS indicate?;The connection to the website is encrypted and secure.;security
What is a Firewall?;A system that monitors and controls incoming/outgoing network traffic based on security rules.;security
Why should you update software regularly?;Updates often contain patches for security vulnerabilities that hackers could exploit.;security
What is Ransomware?;Malware that encrypts your files and demands payment to unlock them.;security
